sections.ingredients:

sections.dosage:
Take 125 mg to 250 mg – 1 – 2 tablets once or twice a day before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor.

sections.side_effects:
Take this medicine strictly only under medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous.

 It should be avoided in children and pregnant ladies.

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Poorna Chandrodaya Ras 
 Reference: Basavarajeeyam 
 Poorna Chandrodaya Ras is an Ayurvedic medicine available in tablet form. This medicine is used for rejuvenation, convalescent and aphrodisiac therapy. It balances tridoshas – Vata, Pitta and Kapha. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Parada – Purified and processed Mercury 
 Gandhaka – Purified and processed Sulphur 
 Swarna Bhasma – Gold Bhasma 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 The above combination of minerals are subjected to a process called as Kupipakva method i.e. Heating of all ingredients with kajjali (sulphur and mercury) to obtain Poorna Chandrodaya Ras. 
 Dosage 
 
 Take 125 mg to 250 mg – 1 – 2 tablets once or twice a day before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 This medicine is traditionally administered along with milk. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Rejuvenation and anti-aging treatment. 
 Aphrodisiac therapy. 
 Convalescent therapy. 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 Take this medicine strictly only under medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous. 
 Over dosage may cause side effects like tremors, dizziness etc. 
 It should be avoided in children and pregnant ladies. 
 Make sure to take this medicine only in the prescribed dose and for the prescribed period of time. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
